content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) FUNWAVE-TVD MODULE PARAM (L64-L88): 'the module to define all fixed parameters' @L57 (HISTORY 05/01/2010 Fengyan Shi @L60; BSD license header L12-L55, FILE mod_param.F @L14). USE MPI @L65, IMPLICIT NONE @L66. Defines the working real kind SP=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30) @L67 (single precision) and its MPI datatype MPI_SP=MPI_REAL @L68; ten named physical/numerical PARAMETER constants (L71-L80: pi, R_earth, SMALL, LARGE, grav, zero, RHO_AW relative air/water density, RHO_AIR absolute, RHO_WATER, DEG2RAD); and shared scratch variables I,J,K,RES @L83, itmp1-itmp5 @L84, tmp1-tmp5 @L85. No executable code.
entities: MODULE PARAM @L64; USE MPI @L65; IMPLICIT NONE @L66; END MODULE PARAM @L88
REAL(SP),PARAMETER :: pi @L71; R_earth @L72; SMALL @L73; LARGE @L74; grav @L75; zero @L76; RHO_AW @L77; RHO_AIR @L78; RHO_WATER @L79; DEG2RAD @L80
INTEGER :: I,J,K,RES @L83; INTEGER :: itmp1,itmp2,itmp3,itmp4,itmp5 @L84; REAL(SP) :: tmp1,tmp2,tmp3,tmp4,tmp5 @L85
unresolved: pi @L71 is the only PARAMETER literal without an _SP kind suffix (default real, then converted); DEG2RAD @L80 = 0.0175 is a truncated pi/180 (0.017453...) — precision relation with pi @L71 is implicit, not stated in the file

Module-level mutable scratch variables I,J,K,RES @L83 and itmp/tmp sets @L84-L85 are shared across every routine that USEs PARAM (no SAVE statement, no protection) — which routines rely on them is not determinable from this file

SP=SELECTED_REAL_KIND(6,30) @L67 fixes single precision and MPI_SP=MPI_REAL @L68 must stay consistent with it; any double-precision build would need both changed together (cross-line relation L67-L68)
